scope: One nominal opt-in development attempt on the conventional marked simulation sheet. The prior strict M5 verdict and all signed gates remain unchanged.
trigger: After routine closed-jaw back-off, a fresh direct slit with a valid same-tick chart and finite optical progress at or above the printed 6 mm landmark arms the one-shot review. Only optical progress and fresh frame identity may arm it; never use the number of closures or hidden material length.
action: Keep jaws closed. Use one real collision/RCM-guarded ECM move charged to the existing camera budget. Check existing grasp, strain, fault, tear and structural overcut interlocks before and after. No retry, cutter advance, opening, or additional closure during or after verification.
visual_gate: On one new native RGB-D exposure require the existing fresh direct slit/chart and 9–10 mm optical progress, bilateral v3 row-9 support, and the same-frame three-marker/fixed-depth tip gate. The local reader can only corroborate, not substitute for the original progress threshold. If any evidence is missing, inconsistent, or below target, hold and report FAILED, not a successful stop.
score: Seal image-only review logs and optical frame hashes, then independently score the first structural 9–10 mm tick, any closures at or after that tick, whether the exact reviewed tick caused guarded closed withdrawal, final measured jaws and ready pose, no tear/fault/overcut, DONE and strict truth isolation. Earliest protected hold without valid visual verification is not Level 0.
